findings.title: Route's hostnames are served by none of its Gateway's listeners
findings.cause: HTTPRoute shop serves shop.example.com, and the listeners of Gateway public it attaches to serve *.store.example.com (listener http): no hostname is in both, so the Gateway sends none of the route's requests to it

evidence.command: kubectl get httproute shop -n kd-gateway-hostname-mismatch -o jsonpath='{.spec.hostnames}'

evidence.what: Gateway public has listeners http (port 80, HTTP, *.store.example.com)
evidence.command: kubectl get gateway public -n kd-gateway-hostname-mismatch -o jsonpath='{.spec.listeners}'

findings.fix: Correct the hostnames of HTTPRoute shop, or add a listener to Gateway public that serves them (a listener with no hostname serves every name).
